# EchelonFox

> EchelonFox is a revenue operations consultancy. Revenue operations means marketing, sales and customer retention run as one system. We find where established B2B companies lose revenue they have already earned, fix it, and keep it fixed. Typical leaks: enquiries and quote requests that are never answered or followed up, customers who quietly stopped ordering, a pipeline that lives in inboxes and spreadsheets, and marketing spend nobody can trace to revenue.

## Offers and prices

Every engagement starts with the Diagnostic. After it, a client takes one of two paths.

- [Revenue Leak Diagnostic](https://echelonfox.com/what-we-do#diagnostic): From $2,000, fixed fee, two weeks. A costed, ranked list of where revenue is being lost. The fee is credited to a Build signed within 30 days.
- [Build](https://echelonfox.com/what-we-do#build) (path A): From $6,000, fixed scope, six to eight weeks. Fixes the top one or two leaks: workflow, CRM setup, follow-up and reporting. Includes training and 30 days of fixes.
- [Run](https://echelonfox.com/what-we-do#run) (path A): From $1,000 a month. Three-month minimum, then monthly. We operate what we built, make a fixed number of changes each month and report one revenue number weekly against the starting baseline.
- [Embedded Growth Team](https://echelonfox.com/embedded-growth-team) (path B): From $4,200 a month. Six-month minimum. A part-time head of growth plus our technical team, working inside the client's business.

## Marketing scope

We capture and route enquiries, write follow-up and nurture emails, run campaigns to win back lapsed customers, track which sources produce revenue, and report. We do not perform SEO, paid advertising, content production or social media management; we plan them and manage the specialists who do them.
